## Supabase Connection Setup

### 1. Get Your Project URL
- Go to your [Supabase Dashboard](https://supabase.com/dashboard)
- Select your project
- Go to **Settings** → **API**
- Copy the **Project URL** (format: `https://your-project-ref.supabase.co`)

### 2. Get Your API Key
Choose the appropriate key based on your use case:

**For Actions (Database Operations):**
- Use **Service Role Key** (secret) for server-side operations
- Has full access to bypass Row Level Security (RLS)

**For Triggers (Webhooks):**
- Use **Anonymous Key** (public) if your webhooks don't need elevated permissions
- Use **Service Role Key** for elevated permissions

**Security Note:** Keep your Service Role Key secret - it bypasses all RLS policies.

Find your keys in **Settings** → **API** → **Project API keys**

apiKey.description: Service Role Key (for actions) or Anonymous Key (for basic triggers)

upload-file.name: upload-file
upload-file.description: Upload a file to Supabase Storage

aiMetadata.description: Uploads a file (provided as base64 or a URL) to a Supabase Storage bucket at a given path, then returns its public URL. Use to persist binary content (images, documents, exports) in object storage rather than a database table. Not idempotent: each call writes the object and will error if the path already exists in the bucket.

create_row.description: Create a new row in a table

instructions.description:
## Setup Instructions

1. **Go to your Supabase Dashboard** → Database → Webhooks
2. **Click "Create a new hook"**
3. **Configure the webhook:**
   - **Name**: Give it a descriptive name (e.g., "Activepieces New Row")
   - **Table**: Select the table you want to monitor
   - **Events**: Check "Insert" 
   - **Type**: HTTP Request
   - **Method**: POST
   - **URL**: Copy and paste the webhook URL below
4. **Click "Create webhook"**

**Webhook URL:** `{{webhookUrl}}`

## Important Notes
- The webhook will send a JSON payload with the new row data
- Make sure your table has the necessary permissions
- You can test the webhook by inserting a new row into your table

For more details, see [Supabase Database Webhooks documentation](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/webhooks).

## Supabase Connectie Setup

### 1. Krijg uw project-URL
- Ga naar uw [Supabase Dashboard](https://supabase.com/dashboard)
- Selecteer uw project
- Ga naar **instellingen** → **API**
- kopieer de **project-URL** (formaat: `https://your-project-ref. upabase.co`)

### 2. Krijg uw API-sleutel
Kies de juiste sleutel op basis van uw gebruiksdoel:

**For Acties (Database Operations):**
- Gebruik **Service Role Key** (secret) voor server-side operaties
- Heeft volledige toegang om Row Level Security (RLS) te omzeilen (RLS)

**Voor Triggers (Webhooks):**
- Gebruik **Anonieme Key** (publiek) als uw webhooks geen verheven rechten nodig heeft
- Gebruik **Service Role Key** voor verhoogde permissies

**Security Note:** Houd uw Service Role Key - Al het beleid.

## Supabase Connection Setup

### 1. Get Your Project URL
- Go to your [Supabase Dashboard](https://supabase.com/dashboard)
- Select your project
- Go to **Settings** → **API**
- Copy the **Project URL** (format: `https://your-project-ref.supabase.co`)

### 2. Get Your API Key
Choose the appropriate key based on your use case:

**For Actions (Database Operations):**
- Use **Service Role Key** (secret) for server-side operations
- Has full access to bypass Row Level Security (RLS)

**For Triggers (Webhooks):**
- Use **Anonymous Key** (public) if your webhooks don't need elevated permissions
- Use **Service Role Key** for elevated permissions

**Security Note:** Keep your Service Role Key secret - it bypasses all RLS policies.

Find your keys in **Settings** → **API** → **Project API keys**

## Instruções de configuração

1. **Vá para seu painel de suporte** → Banco de dados → Webhooks

. **Clique em "Create a new hook"**
3. **Configure o webhook:**
   - **Nome**: Dê um nome descritivo (por exemplo, "Activepieces New Row")
   - **Tabela**: Selecione a tabela que você quer monitorar
   - **Eventos**: Verifique "Insert" 
   - **Tipo**: HTTP Request
   - **Método**: POST
   - **URL**: copie e cole o URL do webhook abaixo
4. **Clique em "Create webhook"**

**Webhook URL:** `{{webhookUrl}}` 

 ## Notas Importantes
- O webhook vai enviar uma carga JSON com os novos dados de linha
- Certifique-se de que sua tabela tem as permissões necessárias
- Você pode testar o webhook inserindo uma nova linha na sua tabela

Para mais detalhes veja [Supabase Database Webhooks documentation](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/webhooks).
